feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 September 2026 10:36pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 09 September 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure system near Iceland bringing a frontal zone across the Irish Sea tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, perhaps occasionally 7 late morning and early afternoon. Then veering west or southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate tomorrow morning, perhaps occasionally rough for a time around midday or early afternoon. Then becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle spread from the west tomorrow morning, before clearing later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, then decreasing 3 or 4 later, then backing southwesterly.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight overnight into Friday.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
